answer: Let every identity climb toward the summit by stacking verified tasks, each sealed in a public ocean of records. Each epoch a sparrow — one randomly drawn lightweight auditor — swoops on a single past task and re-derives it from public records. An honest agent climbs one step per epoch and passes the sparrow cheaply. A fake whose task fails re-derivation falls to the base and loses its weight. An attacker with a thousand fakes must keep a thousand complete histories re-derivable under random sparrow audits every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
